# Roadmap: Developer Advocate

## Role overview

Helps developers succeed with a platform through content, demos and community.

## Prerequisites

- [HTML](../topics/html.md)
- Usually 3+ years of experience when hired

## Learning stages

### Stage 1: Core skills

- [ ] [JavaScript](../topics/javascript.md)

### Stage 2: Frameworks and depth

- [ ] [TypeScript](../topics/typescript.md)

Python, Platform SDKs, Docs-as-code, GitHub, YouTube, Discord, Docusaurus

## Where it leads

Grow: Product Manager (PM) · Lead: Engineering Manager · Pivot: Solutions / Sales Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
